ImageDescription.value: Comparisons between Dicynodon angielczyki and Dicynodon lacerticeps. GPIT/RE/ 7177, referred specimen of Dicynodon angielczyki, in (A) dorsal view. RC 23, referred specimen of Dicynodon lacerticeps (holotype of D. cadlei), in (B) dorsal and (D) left lateral views. UMZC T1089, holotype of Dicynodon angielczyki, in (C) left lateral view. Autapomorphies of Dicynodon angielczyki labeled on the figure: (1) medially-curved squamosal flange at posterolateral edge of temporal fenestra (extensively restored in plaster in this specimen, but sharp curvature at rear edge of squamosal shows it was present; this morphology is clearly preserved in other Dicynodon angielczyki specimens); (2) zygomatic arched bowed laterally (shown in A) and dorsoventrally expanded (shown in C) below and immediately behind the postorbital bar. Scale bars equal five cm. Photos: Christian Kammerer.

ImageDescription.value: A paleoart reconstruction the fauna of the Rio do Rasto  Formation, showcasing a temporary body of water surrounded by vegetation in a dunal environment. In and around the body of water are the genus Tiarajudens, Endothiodon, Rastodon, Bageherpeton, Triodus, Provelosaurus and a unidentified species of Tapinocephalidae. Sitting on a dune on the backround is a Pampaphoneus with its young.
